definitions.explanation: The outer covering of the human body. More technical/medical than {肌|はだ}.

examples.japanese: {皮膚|ひふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧している。
⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{皮膚|ひふ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: Ultraviolet rays have a bad effect on the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧と{皮膚|ひふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧して、⟦かゆく→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ことがある。
examples.english: In winter, the skin can become dry and itchy.

examples.japanese: {皮膚|ひふ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}い→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦{発疹|ほっしん}→発疹：20451_hasshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧ので、⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受診|じゅしん}した→受診：11890_jushin⟧。
examples.english: I got a red rash on my skin, so I immediately visited a dermatologist.

notes:
{皮膚|ひふ} is the formal/medical term for skin — the outer covering of the body.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧: dermatology
- {皮膚|ひふ}⟦{炎|えん}→炎：noentry⟧: dermatitis, skin inflammation
- {皮膚|ひふ}⟦{病|びょう}→病：noentry⟧: skin disease
- {皮膚|ひふ}⟦{科医|かい}→科医：noentry⟧: dermatologist
- {皮膚|ひふ}⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧: skin graft

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: skin (everyday, often about texture/appearance)
- ⟦{素肌|すはだ}→素肌：20256_suhada⟧: bare skin
- ⟦{地肌|じはだ}→地肌：20380_jihada⟧: bare skin, scalp

USAGE:
{皮膚|ひふ} is the technical/medical term, while ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ is the everyday word. {肌|はだ}がきれい (beautiful skin) is natural; {皮膚|ひふ}がきれい sounds clinical. However, ⟦{皮膚科|ひふか}→皮膚科：11073_hifuka⟧ (dermatology) is a very common word even in everyday life.
